headings.text: Build from the repo: the four proofs
(i) an Atelier chrome film: build, then the 10-row gate
(ii) the module operad: lint a beat graph, then compose and build it in one material
(iii) the plan library: lint (L1-L13 + p5 budget) and build the base-rate film
(iv) the SVG episode gate and the plan-module tests

readme.first_paragraph: Short-course explainers for sheaves, operads, and cohomology — for people who do not live in journals.

manifests.name: ceti-explainer-atelier
manifests.description: CETI explainer studio: the SVG episode engine, the p5 film tier (Explainer Atelier runtime, eight chromes, the AM module operad and materials), the plan-compiled explainer library, and the p5 studio skills, in one plugin with vendored p5 2.3.4 and fonts.

dependents: not knowable from a local clone (who imports or vendors this repo lives outside it)
